The '''''Coruscani Flame''''' was a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Rale]] served aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Shore Leave|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>
